name: tracelens
description: A local-first, ephemeral Firefox privacy analyzer.

scripts.build: npm run data:check && npm run typecheck && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && node --require ./scripts/validator-guard.cjs ./node_modules/web-ext/bin/web-ext.js build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist --firefox /usr/bin/firefox
scripts.validate:firefox: npm run build && node --require ./scripts/validator-guard.cjs ./node_modules/web-ext/bin/web-ext.js lint --source-dir dist --warnings-as-errors
